newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Austin Asis assigns AAA rating to Brazil top banks.
newsitem.headline: Austin Asis assigns AAA rating to Brazil top banks.

text.p: Local banking consulting firm Austin Asis on Tuesday said it had upgraded to AAA from AA its ratings on Brazil's top two private banks Bradesco and Banco Itau.
It also upgraded Unibanco, the country's third top private bank, to AA from A, said Erivelto Rodrigues, director at Austin Asis.

The firm, which has rated banks for five years, assigned ratings to 27 financial institutions, including private and state-owned banks, based on their first half results. Austin Asis also raised its ratings on HSBC Bamerindus and government bank Banco do Brasil to BB from CCC.
The triple A rating means that the bank's financial risk is nearly nul; the double A means minimal risk; the double B, medium risk and the triple C, high risk, the firm said in a statement.
